name: Reversing Martingale
summary: This EA implements a reversing martingale strategy that doubles the lot size after each losing trade while attempting to recover losses through progressively larger positions. It enters trades based on a reversal signal logic, increasing exposure after consecutive losses to capitalize on eventual winning trades. The core premise is that a winning trade after a series of losses will recover previous drawdowns due to the exponential position sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了反转马丁格尔策略，在每次亏损交易后将手数翻倍，试图通过逐步加大的仓位来挽回损失。它基于反转信号逻辑入场，在连续亏损后增加敞口，利用最终盈利交易来恢复回撤。核心前提是，由于指数级仓位管理，一系列亏损后的盈利交易将挽回之前的亏损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用反转马丁格尔策略，核心概念是在亏损后翻倍加仓以期一次盈利覆盖所有前期亏损。入场条件通常基于价格反转信号，如超买超卖指标或支撑阻力位的反弹，在出现亏损后按马丁格尔倍数增加手数重新入场。出场条件依赖于止盈目标达到足以覆盖前期累计亏损的水平，但止损设置可能不够完善或缺失。仓位管理采用经典的马丁格尔倍增法，每次亏损后手数乘以2倍因子，盈利后重置为基础手数。资金管理方面存在重大缺陷，因为指数级增长的仓位在连续亏损后会迅速耗尽账户资金，且没有明确的最大连亏次数限制或最大仓位上限保护。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a reversing martingale strategy where the core concept is doubling position size after each loss, aiming for a single win to cover all accumulated losses. Entry conditions are typically based on price reversal signals such as overbought/oversold indicators or support/resistance level bounces, re-entering with multiplied lot sizes after a loss. Exit conditions rely on a take-profit level sufficient to recover all prior cumulative losses, but stop-loss provisions may be inadequate or entirely absent. Position sizing follows the classic martingale doubling method, multiplying the lot size by a factor of 2 after each consecutive loss, resetting to the base lot after a win. Money management has critical flaws because the exponentially growing position size can rapidly deplete the account during extended losing streaks, and there is no explicit maximum consecutive loss limit or maximum position cap for protection.
pros: 在短期赢率较高的市场中，马丁格尔策略能在连亏后通过一次盈利快速回本
策略逻辑简单直观，参数少，易于理解和调优
反转入场逻辑在震荡行情中可能捕捉到较好的反弹机会
pros_en: In markets with high short-term win rates, the martingale approach can quickly recover losses with a single winning trade after consecutive losses
The strategy logic is simple and intuitive with few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
The reversal entry logic may capture good bounce opportunities in ranging markets
cons: 指数级仓位增长在连续亏损时会导致爆仓风险极高，10次连亏手数增长超1000倍
缺乏有效止损机制意味着单次极端行情可能造成不可逆的巨大损失
策略不适应趋势行情，持续单边走势会触发连续加仓导致资金迅速耗尽
心理压力巨大，实盘操作中交易者难以承受马丁格尔策略的回撤幅度
cons_en: Exponential position growth creates extreme blow-up risk during consecutive losses; 10 consecutive losses multiply lot size over 1000x
Lack of effective stop-loss mechanism means a single extreme market move can cause irreversible massive losses
The strategy does not adapt to trending markets; sustained directional moves trigger consecutive position increases that rapidly deplete capital
Enormous psychological pressure; traders in live accounts can rarely withstand the drawdown magnitude of martingale strategies
improvements: 增加硬性最大仓位限制和账户余额百分比止损，防止爆仓风险
加入趋势过滤指标(如均线方向)，避免在强趋势行情中逆势加仓
引入最大回撤保护机制，当账户回撤超过设定阈值时强制平仓并暂停交易
improvements_en: Add a hard maximum position limit and account balance percentage stop-loss to prevent account blow-up
Incorporate trend filter indicators (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend position scaling in strong trending markets
Introduce a maximum drawdown protection mechanism that force-closes all positions and pauses trading when account drawdown exceeds a set threshold

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍增策略在连续亏损时仓位指数级增长，极易导致爆仓
缺少有效止损保护，极端行情下单笔亏损可能达到不可承受水平
没有最大连亏次数的硬性限制，理论上可以无限加仓直到资金耗尽
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling strategy causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses, extremely prone to account blow-up
Lack of effective stop-loss protection means a single extreme market event can cause unaffordable loss levels
No hard limit on maximum consecutive losses means theoretically unlimited position scaling until capital is fully depleted
